mentions.name: Werkbook
mentions.description: This app provides digital forms and photo reports for field crews, offering native iOS and Android apps in addition to its Rails web app, replacing earlier web-view wrappers.
mentions.audience: Field crews that need digital forms and photo reporting on site
mentions.source_excerpt: Werkbook (https://werkbook.app), digital forms and photo reports for field crews. I'm a solo Rails dev, and thanks to Claude it now has native iOS and Android apps instead of Hotwire Native web-view wrappers.
